sql.if: WITH RECURSIVE screen_units AS ( SELECT unit_id FROM base_work_unit WHERE unit_id = #{unitId} AND status = '0' UNION ALL SELECT u.unit_id FROM base_work_unit u JOIN screen_units s ON u.parent_id = s.unit_id WHERE u.status = '0' )
AND wo.work_unit_id IN (SELECT unit_id FROM screen_units)
AND COALESCE(a.unit_id, wo.work_unit_id) IN (SELECT unit_id FROM screen_units)

mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pro_work_order wo WHERE wo.status IN ('1','4','5') ) AS active_work_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pro_work_order wo WHERE wo.status IN ('2','3') AND wo.actual_end_time >= #{today} AND wo.actual_end_time <= #{now} ) AS today_completed_work_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pro_work_order wo WHERE wo.status IN ('1','4','5') AND wo.plan_end_time < #{now} ) AS overdue_work_orders, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM qms_inspection qi JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = qi.work_order_id WHERE qi.status IN ('0','1') ) AS pending_inspections, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM andon_alert a LEFT JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = a.work_order_id WHERE a.status IN ('0','1') AND a.create_time <= #{now} ) AS open_alerts

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = '0' AND e.running_status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS available, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status = '0' AND e.running_status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS fault, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.status <> '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS disabled FROM base_equipment e WHERE 1 = 1 AND e.unit_id IN (SELECT unit_id FROM screen_units)
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pro_work_process pp JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = pp.work_order_id WHERE pp.equipment_id = e.equipment_id AND wo.assignee_user_id = #{userId})

SELECT COUNT(*) AS inspected, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN qi.result = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS passed FROM qms_inspection qi JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = qi.work_order_id WHERE qi.status = '2' AND qi.inspection_round = 1 AND qi.result IN ('P','F') AND qi.inspection_time >= #{start} AND qi.inspection_time <= #{now}

SELECT DATE(qi.inspection_time) AS date, COUNT(*) AS inspected, SUM(CASE WHEN qi.result = 'P' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed FROM qms_inspection qi JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = qi.work_order_id WHERE qi.status = '2' AND qi.inspection_round = 1 AND qi.result IN ('P','F') AND qi.inspection_time >= #{start} AND qi.inspection_time <= #{now}
GROUP BY DATE(qi.inspection_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT pp.process_id, bp.process_name, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS running, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS waiting, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.status IN ('5','6') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormal, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.status IN ('2','7') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN pp.status IN ('0','9','4') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS queued FROM pro_work_process pp JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = pp.work_order_id JOIN base_process bp ON bp.process_id = pp.process_id WHERE wo.status IN ('1','4','5') AND pp.status != '8' GROUP BY pp.process_id, bp.process_name ORDER BY MIN(pp.step_seq), pp.process_id

SELECT wo.work_order_id, wo.work_order_no, bi.item_name, u.unit_name, wo.plan_qty, wo.unit, wo.status, wo.plan_end_time, COALESCE(p.total_steps, 0) AS total_steps, COALESCE(p.completed_steps, 0) AS completed_steps, CASE WHEN wo.status IN ('1','4','5') AND wo.plan_end_time < #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS overdue FROM pro_work_order wo LEFT JOIN base_item bi ON bi.item_id = wo.item_id LEFT JOIN base_work_unit u ON u.unit_id = wo.work_unit_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT work_order_id, COUNT(*) AS total_steps, SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('2','7') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_steps FROM pro_work_process WHERE status != '8' GROUP BY work_order_id) p ON p.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id WHERE wo.status NOT IN ('0','6') AND (wo.status IN ('1','4','5') OR (wo.actual_end_time >= #{start} AND wo.actual_end_time <= #{now}))
ORDER BY CASE WHEN wo.status IN ('1','4','5') AND wo.plan_end_time < #{now} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, CASE WHEN wo.status = '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, CASE WHEN wo.status IN ('1','4') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, wo.plan_end_time IS NULL, wo.plan_end_time, wo.work_order_id DESC LIMIT 12

SELECT a.alert_id, a.alert_no, a.alert_type, a.alert_level, a.status, a.create_time, u.unit_name, e.equipment_name FROM andon_alert a LEFT JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = a.work_order_id LEFT JOIN base_work_unit u ON u.unit_id = COALESCE(a.unit_id, wo.work_unit_id) LEFT JOIN base_equipment e ON e.equipment_id = a.equipment_id WHERE a.status IN ('0','1') AND a.create_time <= #{now} ORDER BY a.alert_level DESC, a.create_time, a.alert_id LIMIT 8

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(d.defect_type, ''), '未分类') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM qms_defect d JOIN pro_work_order wo ON wo.work_order_id = d.work_order_id WHERE d.create_time >= #{start} AND d.create_time <= #{now} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(d.defect_type, ''), '未分类') ORDER BY value DESC, name LIMIT 5

SELECT u.unit_id, u.unit_name, u.unit_type FROM base_work_unit u WHERE u.status = '0' AND u.unit_type IN ('W','L','S')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pro_work_order wo WHERE wo.work_unit_id = u.unit_id AND wo.assignee_user_id = #{userId})
ORDER BY CASE u.unit_type WHEN 'W' THEN 1 WHEN 'L' THEN 2 WHEN 'S' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, u.unit_id
